title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: I was thinking too much on late drop

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba: I was thinking too much on late drop
sources.description: Wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba has come through for the Seahawks many times over the past couple of seasons, but he wasn't able to do so late in Sunday's 32-29 loss to the 49ers.
